name: Noxious Fang
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Noxious Fang

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +2 Enhancement Bonus : +2 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Poisonous
effects.tooltip: Poisonous 2 : This effect causes the edges of this weapon to drip with a vile venom, dealing 2d6 poison damage on each hit.

effects.name: Critical Befouling
effects.tooltip: Critical Befouling 1 : This deadly weapon saps the charm from your enemies, dealing 1 Charisma damage on each critical hit.

effects.name: Fortitude Save
effects.tooltip: Fortitude Save +4 : This item gives a +4 Resistance bonus to your Fortitude saves.

effects.name: Returning
effects.tooltip: Returning : This missile will return to you.

flavor_text: One of the dread spider Mandible's poisonous fangs was transformed into a throwing knife. It deals poison damage and is enchanted to always return to the thrower.

source.raw: The Snitch , Mandible 's chest (optional named spider)
